name: How do I choose the right wall tile for my kitchen or bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right wall tile for my kitchen or bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best tile depends on room moisture, wall load, and your maintenance preferences. For high-moisture showers, dense porcelain or glazed ceramic provides superior water resistance and simple cleaning. For kitchen backsplashes or decorative accent walls, lighter ceramic, glass, or natural marble offer rich visual detail. Also consider tile weight and size: large-format tiles create fewer grout joints but require exceptionally flat wall framing, while small mosaics conform easily to niche contours but require significantly more grout maintenance over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on moisture exposure, ease of cleaning, and wall support. Opt for porcelain or ceramic in wet areas and marble or glass for decorative accent walls.
